Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters, sort order, and grouping each time you open a project, this feature removes that repetition. Set up a view once — filtered by assignee, due date, priority, or any combination you need — and save it for instant access later, without reconfiguring anything.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you room to organize by project, client, sprint, or personal workflow. Need a teammate to see things exactly the way you do? Views can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filters and stays aligned on what matters most.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no additional cost, whether you're on our starter tier or our top enterprise plan. No setup, no extra configuration screens, no waiting for a future release — just a faster way to get back to the work you care about.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
